samples.message: Each box takes the distance of the planet it names. Select that planet and press Take reading; if Neptune is not on the screen, zoom out.
The light time is the distance in astronomical units times 499 seconds, divided by 3,600 seconds an hour.
4.17 hours. The same arithmetic gives Earth 8.3 minutes and Jupiter 43 minutes; a radio command to a spacecraft at Neptune and its reply would take more than eight hours.

Neptune falls 1 meters from the Sun, 0.00 kilometers, in a model whose Earth is 1.00 centimeters across. That is the same 353,000 Earths whatever the marble: halve it and every distance halves. The Sun is 109 Earths across, 11,741 Earths from the Earth, so a model with visible planets cannot be small.
A marble has a size above zero.
Multiply the length of one astronomical unit in your model by Neptune’s distance in astronomical units.
